Course syllabus
Design of Digital Circuits - A Systems Approach
Digitalteknik
EITF65, 9.0 credits, G2 (First Cycle)

Valid for: 2026/27
Faculty: Faculty of Engineering LTH
Decided by: PLED C/D
Date of Decision: 2026-04-16
    
  
General Information

Main field:  Technology
      
      
        Depth of study relative to the degree requirements:  First cycle, in-depth level of the course cannot be classified
      
      
Mandatory for: D2, E2
Elective for: BME4, C4, F4, Pi4
Language of instruction: The course will be given in Swedish
    
  
Aim
The aim of the course is to give basic knowledge about digital systems. Especially the ability to construct and analyse models is emphasised.
Learning outcomes
Knowledge and understanding
      For a passing grade the student must
be able to identify and formulate problems within the area of digital circuit switching.be able to classify the level of difficulty of problems related to the his/her own level of knowledge.be able to model digital systems of low complexity by use of state descriptions.be able to analyse and describe digital systems of low and medium high complexity.
Competences and skills
      For a passing grade the student must
be able to realise digital systems of low and medium high complexity with digital circuits.be able to show ability to handle new concepts, methods and results.
Judgement and approach
      For a passing grade the student must
be able to show insight concerning possibilities and limitations of digital systems.
Contents
Introduction of basic concepts, especially state descriptions and boolean algebra. Introduction to digital circuit elements, inclusive gates, flip-flops and memory, how these are designed on the transistor level and how they are parts of digital systems. Methods for realisation of state description and combinatorial functions with digital circuits. Analyses and partitioning of digital systems for realisation in form of state machines, combinatorial blocks and memories. Use of hardware description languages, simulation and synthesis.
Examination details

Grading scale: TH - (U, 3, 4, 5) - (Fail, Three, Four, Five)
Assessment: To obtain a pass, passing grades for the compulsory laboratory work and the examination are required. The final grade is based on the result of the examination.

The examiner, in consultation with Disability Support Services, may deviate from the regular form of examination in order to provide a permanently disabled student with a form of examination equivalent to that of a student without a disability.

Modules
Code: 0117. Name: Examination. 

Credits: 4.5. Grading scale: TH - (U, 3, 4, 5).
        
          Assessment: Supervised, digital exam.
        
        
          The module includes: The whole course.
        
        
        
Code: 0217. Name: Laboratory Work. 

Credits: 4.5. Grading scale: UG - (U, G).
        
          Assessment: Passed laboratory lessons.
        
        
          The module includes: The course has five mandatory laboratory sessions. The last one is double work compared with the others. The lab part also includes a final mandatory on-line test.
        
        
        

Admission

The number of participants is limited to: No

Sarah L. Harris, David Harris: Digital Design and Computer Architecture - RISC-V Edition. Morgan Kaufmann, 2022, ISBN: 978-0-12-820064-3.
